ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin (Agenda) pre-encryption sabotage chain: safe-mode reboot + shadow-copy wipe + event-log clear
ucs.description: Hunts Qilin/Agenda's signature pre-encryption sequence on a single host: bcdedit forcing a safeboot-with-networking reboot (to detonate the locker outside EDR), vssadmin/wmic shadow-copy deletion, and wevtutil event-log clearing — observed in Qilin.B and Qilin Rust-builder intrusions and a hallmark of this Russian-speaking RaaS.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_name) as proc values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("bcdedit.exe","vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","wevtutil.exe","net.exe","sc.exe","fsutil.exe") AND (Processes.process="*safeboot*" OR Processes.process="*delete shadows*" OR Processes.process="*shadowcopy delete*" OR Processes.process="*cl Security*" OR Processes.process="*cl System*" OR Processes.process="*cl Application*" OR Processes.process="*usnjrnl deletejournal*" OR Processes.process="*recoveryenabled No*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures*") by host Processes.user _time span=10m | rename Processes.* as * | eventstats dc(proc) as distinctProcs by host user | where distinctProcs >= 2 AND user!="SYSTEM" AND NOT match(user,"\$$")
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMinutes = 15m;
let Sabotage = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe"  and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("safeboot","recoveryenabled","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"))
         or (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadows")
         or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe"     and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete")
         or (FileName =~ "wevtutil.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("cl Security","cl System","cl Application","cl Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational"))
         or (FileName =~ "fsutil.exe"   and ProcessCommandLine has "usnjrnl" and ProcessCommandLine has "deletejournal")
    | extend Bucket = case(
        FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe",  "safeboot_or_recovery",
        FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe", "shadow_delete",
        FileName =~ "wmic.exe",     "shadow_delete",
        FileName =~ "wevtutil.exe", "log_clear",
        FileName =~ "fsutil.exe",   "usnjrnl_wipe",
        "other");
Sabotage
| summarize Buckets = make_set(Bucket),
            Cmds    = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 8),
            Parents = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 5),
            First   = min(Timestamp),
            Last    = max(Timestamp)
            by DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, WindowMinutes)
| where array_length(Buckets) >= 2
| extend HasSafeBoot = Buckets has "safeboot_or_recovery"
| extend Score = array_length(Buckets) + iff(HasSafeBoot, 2, 0)   // safeboot is the Qilin tell
| project First, Last, DeviceName, AccountName, Buckets, Score, Parents, Cmds
| order by Score desc, First desc

ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Qilin/Agenda Pre-Encryption Sabotage (Safe-Mode + Shadow Delete + Log Clear)
id: 9d3f0c5e-2d6a-4f9e-9d4b-q1l1n5af3boot
status: experimental
description: Detects Qilin (Agenda) ransomware pre-encryption tamper chain - bcdedit forcing safeboot-with-networking, shadow-copy deletion via vssadmin/wmic, event-log clearing via wevtutil, and USN-journal wipe via fsutil. Co-occurrence within a short window is high-fidelity for this Russian-speaking RaaS.
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/21
references:
  - https://www.trendmicro.com/en_us/research/24/h/agenda-ransomware.html
  - https://www.group-ib.com/blog/qilin-ransomware/
  - https://www.sentinelone.com/labs/qilin-ransomware-as-a-service/
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.t1562.009
  - attack.t1070.001
  - attack.t1070.004
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_bcdedit_safeboot:
    Image|endswith: '\bcdedit.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'safeboot'
      - 'recoveryenabled No'
      - 'bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures'
  selection_vssadmin:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  selection_wmic_shadow:
    Image|endswith: '\wmic.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'shadowcopy'
      - 'delete'
  selection_wevtutil:
    Image|endswith: '\wevtutil.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'cl Security'
      - 'cl System'
      - 'cl Application'
      - 'cl Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational'
  selection_fsutil:
    Image|endswith: '\fsutil.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'usnjrnl'
      - 'deletejournal'
  filter_machine_account:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: (1 of selection_*) and not filter_machine_account
falsepositives:
  - Authorised disaster-recovery testing executing bcdedit safeboot manually
  - Backup software invoking vssadmin delete shadows during retention rotation
  - IT-helpdesk repair scripts running fsutil usnjrnl deletejournal
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.security OR windows.sysmon) (@EventID:(1 OR 4688)) (@Image:(*\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*safeboot* OR *recoveryenabled* OR *bootstatuspolicy* OR *SAFEBOOT*) OR @Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSAdmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*delete*shadows* OR *Delete*Shadows*) OR @Image:(*\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.exe OR *\\WMIC.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*shadowcopy*delete* OR *ShadowCopy*delete*) OR @Image:(*\\wevtutil.exe OR *\\WevtUtil.exe OR *\\WEVTUTIL.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*"cl Security"* OR *"cl System"* OR *"cl Application"* OR *"cl Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational"*) OR @Image:(*\\fsutil.exe OR *\\FSUtil.exe OR *\\FSUTIL.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*usnjrnl*deletejournal* OR *UsnJrnl*deletejournal*)) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(bcdedit|vssadmin|wmic|wevtutil|fsutil)\.exe$/i
| (
    (ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i AND regex("(?i)(safeboot|recoveryenabled\s+No|bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures)", field=CommandLine))
    OR
    (ImageFileName=/\\vssadmin\.exe$/i AND regex("(?i)delete\s+shadows", field=CommandLine))
    OR
    (ImageFileName=/\\wmic\.exe$/i     AND regex("(?i)shadowcopy.*delete", field=CommandLine))
    OR
    (ImageFileName=/\\wevtutil\.exe$/i  AND regex("(?i)\bcl\s+(Security|System|Application|Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational)", field=CommandLine))
    OR
    (ImageFileName=/\\fsutil\.exe$/i    AND regex("(?i)usnjrnl.*deletejournal", field=CommandLine))
  )
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| Bucket := if(regex("(?i)bcdedit", field=ImageFileName), then="safeboot",
          else=if(regex("(?i)vssadmin|wmic", field=ImageFileName), then="shadow_delete",
          else=if(regex("(?i)wevtutil", field=ImageFileName), then="log_clear",
          else="usnjrnl_wipe")))
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function=[collect([Bucket, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName]), count()])
| _count >= 2

ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin LSASS dump via comsvcs.dll MiniDump LOLBin (T1003.001) preceding SMB/RDP fan-out
ucs.description: Hunts Qilin/Agenda affiliates' favoured fileless LSASS credential dump using rundll32.exe + comsvcs.dll MiniDump (avoiding noisy procdump.exe drops), followed within the hour by SMB/RDP lateral movement to additional hosts — the lateral-pivot pattern documented across Group-IB, Trend Micro and Sophos Qilin IR reports.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as dumpTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name="rundll32.exe" AND (Processes.process="*comsvcs.dll*MiniDump*" OR Processes.process="*comsvcs*#-24*" OR Processes.process="*comsvcs*,MiniDump*") by host Processes.user Processes.process | rename Processes.* as * | rename host as src | join type=inner src [| tstats summariesonly=true count as latMoves values(Authentication.dest) as dest_hosts values(Authentication.authentication_method) as auth_method from datamodel=Authentication where (Authentication.authentication_method IN ("NTLM","Kerberos") OR Authentication.signature_id IN ("4624","4648")) AND Authentication.logon_type IN (3,10) by Authentication.src as src Authentication.user _time span=1h | rename Authentication.* as * | where latMoves >= 3] | where _time <= dumpTime+3600 AND _time >= dumpTime | table dumpTime, src, user, dest_hosts, latMoves, process
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let PivotWindow = 1h;
let LsassDump = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName =~ "rundll32.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has "comsvcs"
         and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("MiniDump","#-24","#24")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project DumpTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              DumpCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              DumpParent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              DumpParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
let LateralMove = DeviceLogonEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType == "LogonSuccess"
    | where LogonType in ("Network", "RemoteInteractive")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project PivotTime = Timestamp, SrcDevice = RemoteDeviceName, SrcIP = RemoteIP,
              DstDevice = DeviceName, AccountName, LogonType;
LsassDump
| join kind=inner (LateralMove) on $left.DeviceName == $right.SrcDevice, AccountName
| where PivotTime between (DumpTime .. DumpTime + PivotWindow)
| summarize DistinctTargets = dcount(DstDevice),
            Targets        = make_set(DstDevice, 25),
            LogonTypes     = make_set(LogonType, 5),
            FirstPivot     = min(PivotTime),
            LastPivot      = max(PivotTime),
            DumpCmd        = any(DumpCmd),
            DumpParent     = any(DumpParent)
            by DumpTime, DeviceName, AccountName
| where DistinctTargets >= 2
| project DumpTime, FirstPivot, LastPivot, DeviceName, AccountName,
          DistinctTargets, LogonTypes, Targets, DumpCmd, DumpParent
| order by DumpTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let PivotWindow = 1h;
let LsassDump = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | extend NewProc = tolower(tostring(NewProcessName))
    | where NewProc endswith "\\rundll32.exe"
    | where CommandLine has "comsvcs"
         and CommandLine has_any ("MiniDump","#-24","#24")
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project DumpTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName,
              DumpCmd = CommandLine,
              DumpParent = ParentProcessName;
let LateralLogons = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4624
    | where LogonType in (3, 10)
    | where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
    | project PivotTime = TimeGenerated, SrcWorkstation = WorkstationName,
              SrcIP = IpAddress, DstComputer = Computer,
              TargetUserName, LogonType;
LsassDump
| join kind=inner (LateralLogons) on $left.Computer == $right.SrcWorkstation,
                                       $left.SubjectUserName == $right.TargetUserName
| where PivotTime between (DumpTime .. DumpTime + PivotWindow)
| summarize DistinctTargets = dcount(DstComputer),
            Targets        = make_set(DstComputer, 25),
            LogonTypes     = make_set(LogonType, 5),
            FirstPivot     = min(PivotTime),
            LastPivot      = max(PivotTime),
            DumpCmd        = any(DumpCmd),
            DumpParent     = any(DumpParent)
            by DumpTime, Computer, SubjectUserName
| where DistinctTargets >= 2
| project TimeGenerated = DumpTime, FirstPivot, LastPivot, Computer, SubjectUserName,
          DistinctTargets, LogonTypes, Targets, DumpCmd, DumpParent
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: LSASS Dump via comsvcs.dll MiniDump (Qilin/Agenda affiliate tradecraft)
id: 7a2c4e1b-8d3f-4c5a-b6e7-qilincomsvcs01
status: experimental
description: Detects fileless LSASS memory dumping via rundll32.exe loading comsvcs.dll and invoking MiniDump (ordinal #-24). Heavily reused by Qilin (Agenda) ransomware affiliates to obtain credentials prior to SMB/RDP lateral movement.
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/21
references:
  - https://www.group-ib.com/blog/qilin-ransomware/
  - https://www.trendmicro.com/en_us/research/24/h/agenda-ransomware.html
  - https://lolbas-project.github.io/lolbas/Libraries/Comsvcs/
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1003.001
  - attack.t1218.011
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'comsvcs'
  modifier_minidump:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'MiniDump'
      - '#-24'
      - '#24'
      - ',MiniDump'
  filter_machine_account:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection and modifier_minidump and not filter_machine_account
falsepositives:
  - Authorised IR / forensic acquisition tooling using comsvcs.dll MiniDump deliberately
  - Microsoft engineering troubleshooting scripts (extremely rare)
level: critical
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.security OR windows.sysmon) (@EventID:(1 OR 4688)) @Image:(*\\rundll32.exe OR *\\RunDll32.exe OR *\\RUNDLL32.EXE) @CommandLine:(*comsvcs* OR *COMSVCS* OR *ComSvcs*) AND @CommandLine:(*MiniDump* OR *minidump* OR *MINIDUMP* OR *#-24* OR *#24*) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\rundll32\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)comsvcs", field=CommandLine)
| regex("(?i)(minidump|#-?24)", field=CommandLine)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| join({
    #event_simpleName=UserLogon
    | LogonType=/^(3|10)$/
    | NOT UserName=/\$$/
    | groupBy([aid, UserName], function=[count(field=ComputerName, distinct=true, as=distinctTargets), collect([ComputerName, LogonType])])
    | distinctTargets >= 2
  }, field=[aid, UserName], include=[distinctTargets, ComputerName, LogonType])
| table([_time, aid, ComputerName, UserName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName, distinctTargets, ComputerName, LogonType])
